name: 3D phone spin
technique: A phone with real thickness (stacked CSS-3D slices, rounded rim, glass) spins in from edge-on and settles into a slow orbit with a real screen on its face; feature chips (from features.json claims) pop out on alternating sides.

chips.label: Chips (comma separated, max 4)
